facilities.name: Motionscentralen Kotten
facilities.description: Fontin/Kotten service cluster with toilets, water claim, cafe, changing rooms, showers, sauna and outdoor gym. Cafe, showers and sauna are opening-hours/fee dependent. Do not model as always-open service.

facilities.name: Kotten - Cafe & Konferens
facilities.description: Cafe/lunch/refreshment service at the Stage 7 start. May duplicate Motionscentralen Kotten service cluster; cluster before runtime import. Opening hours are volatile.

facilities.name: Rastplats Fontin / Svarte Mosse shelter cluster
facilities.description: Picnic/rest area by Svarte Mosse; municipal source confirms wind shelter, grill area and bins in Fontin/Kotten area. OSM marks the shelter as picnic shelter with sleeping=no. Fontin reserve prohibits tenting/caravans. Do not model this picnic shelter as overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Kolebacka overnight cabin
facilities.description: Overnight cabin on Stage 7 with raised sleeping platform, bench/table, grill area, benches and waste bin. Bring own wood. Bring own wood; supplied wood is not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Aleklatten
facilities.description: 2024 wind shelter at Aleklatten viewpoint with grill/fireplace and benches on a short detour from Stage 7. Flag as detour/off-main-line rather than directly on the main route.

facilities.name: Badplats Romesjon
facilities.description: On-route swimming and picnic area. WST marks swim/rest/tent site; municipal page confirms jetty, changing hut, grill, benches, sandy beach and toilet. High-water reports can affect bench/facility usability. Romesjon tenting should be modeled locally, not generalized to Fontin or Svartedalen restrictions.

facilities.name: Parkering Romesjons badplats
facilities.description: Parking for Romesjon bathing place; municipal page says parking is about 400 m from the beach. Exact parking coordinate is OSM-derived; verify before final import.

facilities.name: Dyrods gard
facilities.description: Off-route lodging near Romesjon with cottage/apartment; operator says Bohusleden passes about 1 km from the farm. Commercial availability should be rechecked.

facilities.name: Dalen
facilities.description: Hembygdsgard/picnic stop near the north end. WST marks water, rest area, attraction and toilet; OSM maps manual groundwater pump and pit toilet nearby. Water reliability/opening/seasonality not specified; verify locally before marking always-open potable water.

facilities.name: Etapptavla Grandalen

facilities.name: Busshallplats Grandalen
facilities.description: End-stage bus stop; official stage text warns service is infrequent. Sparse rural service; live-check before relying on it.

facilities.name: Busshallplats Fardevagen

facilities.name: Busshallplats Eriksdal
